setup: LLM agent live PID gain tuning on servo hardware with unguided prompt (safe ranges only)
C1_note: No non-LLM tuning baseline; only vs arbitrary start gains (p.7)
C2_note: IAE, ISE, MAE, RMSE, ITAE, ITSE traces for Run 3 only (pp.12-13)
C4_note: Final gains for 3 runs (Table 1, p.12), ~10 runs (p.15); model and prompt given (App. A.3)
C5_note: Partial: about 1 of ~10 runs aborted without final gains (p.15); approximate count
C6_note: Prompt-stated safe range and ±8 V clip (pp.7,20); agent self-aborted once (App. B.1) but bounds never challenged
loop_timing: PID 500 Hz, logging 50 Hz; metrics updated after each positive square-wave step (pp.5,7,9)
key_result: Unguided agent converged faster (50 to 80 s) but final Kp varied 0.35-0.80 over 3 runs, and about 1 in 10 runs failed (pp.11-12,15)
limitation: Unguided reasoning gave greater variability in final tuning, and ITAE/ITSE stayed high (pp.15-16)
